title: Hill Bolivar Christmas Caroling
seo_title: Hill Bolivar Christmas Caroling in Bolivar, MO
description: Hill Bolivar Christmas Caroling is a night of singing Christmas songs in local neighborhoods, held in place of the normal midweek service. The group meets at The Hill Bolivar at 6:00 PM and heads out together to share songs, smiles, and fellowship. It takes place on December 16, 2026, starting at 2103 S Springfield Ave in Bolivar, MO.
